mapper.sql: SELECT b.*, (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM billing_base_versions v WHERE v.base_id = b.base_id) AS current_version_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_statements s WHERE s.base_id = b.base_id) AS statement_count FROM billing_bases b
mapper.select: WHERE b.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY b.display_order ASC, b.base_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_bases (project_id, base_name, display_order) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{baseName}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT v.*, q.quote_date, q.quote_filepath, q.quote_status FROM billing_base_versions v LEFT JOIN quotes q ON v.quote_id = q.quote_id WHERE v.base_id = #{baseId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_base_versions (base_id, version_no, quote_id, tax_rate) VALUES (#{baseId}, #{versionNo}, #{quoteId}, #{taxRate})
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_base_versions SET quote_id = #{quoteId}, tax_rate = #{taxRate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM billing_base_items WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY display_order ASC, base_item_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_base_items (base_id, version_id, building, item_name, base_quantity, unit, unit_price, excluded_quantity, excluded_reason, display_order) VALUES (#{baseId}, #{versionId}, #{building}, #{itemName}, #{baseQuantity}, #{unit}, #{unitPrice}, #{excludedQuantity}, #{excludedReason}, #{displayOrder})

INSERT INTO billing_base_other_items (base_id, version_id, fee_name, default_unit_price, default_quantity, is_variable, display_order) VALUES (#{baseId}, #{versionId}, #{feeName}, #{defaultUnitPrice}, #{defaultQuantity}, #{isVariable}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, cl.client_name, co.company_name FROM projects p LEFT JOIN clients cl ON p.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN companies co ON p.company_id = co.company_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billing_bases b WHERE b.project_id = p.project_id AND b.stopped_at IS NULL) ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC
